_comment: Documentation word budgets, enforced by tests/docs/test_doc_budgets.py from the ci.yml docs job. Metric: one word per CJK character plus one word per maximal latin/digit run, counted after stripping fenced code blocks and HTML comments. Calibration: README.md and docs/future-roadmap.md are current size +20%, pages/*.md entries were recalibrated to post-expansion size +30% after the contract-body migration. Keys starting with '_' document the manifest and are not budgets.
_agents_note: AGENTS.md migration is complete: the P0 contract bodies now live in pages/ behind stable anchors and this index is all that stays resident, so 2100 (its 1955 words + 10%, rounded to the nearest hundred) is the hard ceiling, no longer a placeholder for a larger target.
_subtree_agents_note: 子目录 AGENTS.md，DSH 层级：pages/AGENTS.md 与 phone_agent/v2/AGENTS.md 是就近约束，沿用 DeepSeek Harness packages/AGENTS.md 的口径，各按 750 词上限校验。
